name: TypeScript Type Generation from Schemas
description: Generate TypeScript types from all schemas using json-schema-to-typescript. Place generated types in appropriate package directories. Run type generation via bun run schema:types. Ensure types stay in sync with schemas.
purpose: Eliminate manual type stubs that drift from schemas. TypeScript types are derived from the canonical schema definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: json-schema-to-typescript generates types from all registry schemas
bun run schema:types regenerates all types
CI verifies types are up-to-date (fails on drift)
Types provide full IDE autocompletion for schema-validated data
